title: Pilot killed in Batangas midair collision laid to rest at Libingan ng mga Bayani
summary: Maj. David Joshua Rojo, one of the four air force pilots killed in a midair collision in Batangas, was laid to rest at the Libingan ng mga Bayani on Thursday, October 29.
